extracted.intended_audience: editors of surgical journals; surgical researchers and authors
extracted.subtask_description: Assessment of whether surgical journal author instructions formally endorse key reporting guidance (CONSORT for RCTs, PRISMA for systematic reviews) and related publication standards. Useful for editors updating instructions and researchers submitting manuscripts to surgical journals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conflict of interests (COI) guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Author guidelines were scrutinised for guidance on conflict of interests (COI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The study found COI guidance present in 82% of journals. Journals with editorial offices in the UK were more likely to insist on disclosure of COI.

rubrics_metrics.name: Uniform Requirements for Manuscripts (URM) endorsement
rubrics_metrics.description: Author guidelines were checked for endorsement of the Uniform Requirements for Manuscripts (URM).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: 62% of journals endorsed the URM according to the survey.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical trial registration requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Author guidelines were checked for guidance requiring clinical trial registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only 32% of journals endorsed trial registration in their instructions. Journals with higher impact were more likely to adopt trial registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: CONSORT endorsement for randomised controlled trials
rubrics_metrics.description: Author guidelines were checked for formal endorsement of CONSORT (Consolidated Standards of Reporting Trials) for reporting randomised controlled trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CONSORT was endorsed by 29% of journals in the sample. Journals with higher impact were more likely to adopt CONSORT, and journals with UK editorial offices were more likely to endorse CONSORT.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA endorsement for systematic reviews/meta-analyses
rubrics_metrics.description: Author guidelines were checked for formal endorsement of PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) for reporting systematic reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PRISMA endorsement was present in 10% of journals. Higher impact journals were more likely to adopt PRISMA.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updating author instructions to endorse reporting guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Editors should uniformly endorse reporting guidance and update their instructions to authors to reflect published reporting standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The authors conclude that published reporting guidelines have not been widely implemented by surgical journals and that failure to implement such guidance may contribute to poorer quality of published research; therefore journal editors are advised to update instructions to authors to include and enforce reporting guidance (e.g., CONSORT, PRISMA, trial registration, COI, URM).
